payload.author: codex
payload.body: Implemented the Rust auth lifecycle seam for CR-108. Frick now exposes BootSeams.auth_lifecycle with AuthLifecycle::on_first_sign_in and resolve_session, wires it into AppStateInner, calls it from /auth/email/signup, /auth/email/login, and provider verify find/create paths, and preserves default behavior through NoopAuthLifecycle. Added Frick email-auth integration coverage proving hook-selected tenantId/userId/displayName on first signup, no second first-sign-in hook on returning login, and session resolution for returning auth. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p frick-server; cargo check -p frick-server; cargo test -p frick-server auth_lifecycle_can_choose_first_signup_and_returning_session_fields -- --nocapture.
